args.device: Linux server running the net-snmp agent

cands.name: hrDeviceDescr
cands.description: A textual description of this device, including the device's manufacturer and revision, and optionally, its serial number.

cands.name: hrDeviceErrors
cands.description: The number of errors detected on this device. It should be noted that as this object has a SYNTAX of Counter32, that it does not have a defined initial value. However, it is recommended that this object be initialized to zero, even though management stations must not depend on such an initialization

cands.name: hrDeviceID
cands.description: The product ID for this device.

cands.name: hrDeviceIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each device contained by the host. The value for each device must remain constant at least from one re-initialization of the agent to the next re-initialization.

cands.name: hrDeviceStatus
cands.description: The current operational state of the device described by this row of the table. A value unknown(1) indicates that the current state of the device is unknown. running(2) indicates that the device is up and running and that no unusual error conditions are known. The warning(3) state indicates that age

cands.name: hrDeviceType
cands.description: An indication of the type of device. If this value is `hrDeviceProcessor { hrDeviceTypes 3 }' then an entry exists in the hrProcessorTable which corresponds to this device. If this value is `hrDeviceNetwork { hrDeviceTypes 4 }', then an entry exists in the hrNetworkTable which corresponds to this de

cands.name: hrDiskStorageAccess
cands.description: An indication if this long-term storage device is readable and writable or only readable. This should reflect the media type, any write-protect mechanism, and any device configuration that affects the entire device.

cands.name: hrDiskStorageCapacity
cands.description: The total size for this long-term storage device. If the media is removable and is currently removed, this value should be zero.

cands.name: hrDiskStorageMedia
cands.description: An indication of the type of media used in this long- term storage device.

cands.name: hrDiskStorageRemoveble
cands.description: Denotes whether or not the disk media may be removed from the drive.

cands.name: hrFSAccess
cands.description: An indication if this file system is logically configured by the operating system to be readable and writable or only readable. This does not represent any local access-control policy, except one that is applied to the file system as a whole.

cands.name: hrFSBootable
cands.description: A flag indicating whether this file system is bootable.

cands.name: hrFSIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each file system local to this host. The value for each file system must remain constant at least from one re-initialization of the agent to the next re-initialization.

cands.name: hrFSLastFullBackupDate
cands.description: The last date at which this complete file system was copied to another storage device for backup. This information is useful for ensuring that backups are being performed regularly. If this information is not known, then this variable shall have the value corresponding to January 1, year 0000, 00:00

cands.name: hrFSLastPartialBackupDate
cands.description: The last date at which a portion of this file system was copied to another storage device for backup. This information is useful for ensuring that backups are being performed regularly. If this information is not known, then this variable shall have the value corresponding to January 1, year 0000, 0

cands.name: hrFSMountPoint
cands.description: The path name of the root of this file system.

cands.name: hrFSRemoteMountPoint
cands.description: A description of the name and/or address of the server that this file system is mounted from. This may also include parameters such as the mount point on the remote file system. If this is not a remote file system, this string should have a length of zero.

cands.name: hrFSStorageIndex
cands.description: The index of the hrStorageEntry that represents information about this file system. If there is no such information available, then this value shall be zero. The relevant storage entry will be useful in tracking the percent usage of this file system and diagnosing errors that may occur when it runs

cands.name: hrFSType
cands.description: The value of this object identifies the type of this file system.

cands.name: hrMemorySize
cands.description: The amount of physical read-write main memory, typically RAM, contained by the host.

cands.name: hrNetworkIfIndex
cands.description: The value of ifIndex which corresponds to this network device. If this device is not represented in the ifTable, then this value shall be zero.

cands.name: hrPartitionFSIndex
cands.description: The index of the file system mounted on this partition. If no file system is mounted on this partition, then this value shall be zero. Note that multiple partitions may point to one file system, denoting that that file system resides on those partitions. Multiple file systems may not reside on one p

cands.name: hrPartitionID
cands.description: A descriptor which uniquely represents this partition to the responsible operating system. On some systems, this might take on a binary representation.

cands.name: hrPartitionIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each partition on this long-term storage device. The value for each long-term storage device must remain constant at least from one re- initialization of the agent to the next re- initialization.

cands.name: hrPartitionLabel
cands.description: A textual description of this partition.

cands.name: hrPartitionSize
cands.description: The size of this partition.

cands.name: hrPrinterDetectedErrorState
cands.description: This object represents any error conditions detected by the printer. The error conditions are encoded as bits in an octet string, with the following definitions: Condition Bit # lowPaper 0 noPaper 1 lowToner 2 noToner 3 doorOpen 4 jammed 5 offline 6 serviceRequested 7 inputTrayMissing 8 outputTrayMi

cands.name: hrPrinterStatus
cands.description: The current status of this printer device.

cands.name: hrProcessorFrwID
cands.description: The product ID of the firmware associated with the processor.

cands.name: hrProcessorLoad
cands.description: The average, over the last minute, of the percentage of time that this processor was not idle. Implementations may approximate this one minute smoothing period if necessary.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledDate
cands.description: The last-modification date of this application as it would appear in a directory listing. If this information is not known, then this variable shall have the value corresponding to January 1, year 0000, 00:00:00.0, which is encoded as (hex)'00 00 01 01 00 00 00 00'.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledID
cands.description: The product ID of this installed piece of software.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each piece of software installed on the host. This value shall be in the range from 1 to the number of pieces of software installed on the host.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledLastChange
cands.description: The value of sysUpTime when an entry in the hrSWInstalledTable was last added, renamed, or deleted. Because this table is likely to contain many entries, polling of this object allows a management station to determine when re-downloading of the table might be useful.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledLastUpdateTime
cands.description: The value of sysUpTime when the hrSWInstalledTable was last completely updated. Because caching of this data will be a popular implementation strategy, retrieval of this object allows a management station to obtain a guarantee that no data in this table is older than the indicated time.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledName
cands.description: A textual description of this installed piece of software, including the manufacturer, revision, the name by which it is commonly known, and optionally, its serial number.

cands.name: hrSWInstalledType
cands.description: The type of this software.

cands.name: hrSWOSIndex
cands.description: The value of the hrSWRunIndex for the hrSWRunEntry that represents the primary operating system running on this host. This object is useful for quickly and uniquely identifying that primary operating system.

cands.name: hrSWRunID
cands.description: The product ID of this running piece of software.

cands.name: hrSWRunIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each piece of software running on the host. Wherever possible, this should be the system's native, unique identification number.

cands.name: hrSWRunName
cands.description: A textual description of this running piece of software, including the manufacturer, revision, and the name by which it is commonly known. If this software was installed locally, this should be the same string as used in the corresponding hrSWInstalledName.

cands.name: hrSWRunParameters
cands.description: A description of the parameters supplied to this software when it was initially loaded.

cands.name: hrSWRunPath
cands.description: A description of the location on long-term storage (e.g. a disk drive) from which this software was loaded.

cands.name: hrSWRunPerfCPU
cands.description: The number of centi-seconds of the total system's CPU resources consumed by this process. Note that on a multi-processor system, this value may increment by more than one centi-second in one centi-second of real (wall clock) time.

cands.name: hrSWRunPerfMem
cands.description: The total amount of real system memory allocated to this process.

cands.name: hrSWRunStatus
cands.description: The status of this running piece of software. Setting this value to invalid(4) shall cause this software to stop running and to be unloaded. Sets to other values are not valid.

cands.name: hrSWRunType
cands.description: The type of this software.

cands.name: hrStorageAllocationFailures
cands.description: The number of requests for storage represented by this entry that could not be honored due to not enough storage. It should be noted that as this object has a SYNTAX of Counter32, that it does not have a defined initial value. However, it is recommended that this object be initialized to zero, even

cands.name: hrStorageAllocationUnits
cands.description: The size, in bytes, of the data objects allocated from this pool. If this entry is monitoring sectors, blocks, buffers, or packets, for example, this number will commonly be greater than one. Otherwise this number will typically be one.

cands.name: hrStorageDescr
cands.description: A description of the type and instance of the storage described by this entry.

cands.name: hrStorageIndex
cands.description: A unique value for each logical storage area contained by the host.

cands.name: hrStorageSize
cands.description: The size of the storage represented by this entry, in units of hrStorageAllocationUnits. This object is writable to allow remote configuration of the size of the storage area in those cases where such an operation makes sense and is possible on the underlying system. For example, the amount of main

cands.name: hrStorageType
cands.description: The type of storage represented by this entry.

cands.name: hrStorageUsed
cands.description: The amount of the storage represented by this entry that is allocated, in units of hrStorageAllocationUnits.

cands.name: hrSystemDate
cands.description: The host's notion of the local date and time of day.

cands.name: hrSystemInitialLoadDevice
cands.description: The index of the hrDeviceEntry for the device from which this host is configured to load its initial operating system configuration (i.e., which operating system code and/or boot parameters). Note that writing to this object just changes the configuration that will be used the next time the operatin

cands.name: hrSystemInitialLoadParameters
cands.description: This object contains the parameters (e.g. a pathname and parameter) supplied to the load device when requesting the initial operating system configuration from that device. Note that writing to this object just changes the configuration that will be used the next time the operating system is loaded

cands.name: hrSystemMaxProcesses
cands.description: The maximum number of process contexts this system can support. If there is no fixed maximum, the value should be zero. On systems that have a fixed maximum, this object can help diagnose failures that occur when this maximum is reached.

cands.name: hrSystemNumUsers
cands.description: The number of user sessions for which this host is storing state information. A session is a collection of processes requiring a single act of user authentication and possibly subject to collective job control.

cands.name: hrSystemProcesses
cands.description: The number of process contexts currently loaded or running on this system.

cands.name: hrSystemUptime
cands.description: The amount of time since this host was last initialized. Note that this is different from sysUpTime in the SNMPv2-MIB [RFC1907] because sysUpTime is the uptime of the network management portion of the system.

cands.name: dskAvail
cands.description: Available space on the disk. For large lightly-used disks (>2Tb), this value will latch at INT32_MAX (2147483647).

cands.name: dskAvailHigh
cands.description: Available space on the disk (kBytes). Together with dskAvailLow composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: dskAvailLow
cands.description: Available space on the disk (kBytes). Together with dskAvailHigh composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: dskDevice
cands.description: Path of the device for the partition

cands.name: dskErrorFlag
cands.description: Error flag signaling that the disk or partition is under the minimum required space configured for it.

cands.name: dskErrorMsg
cands.description: A text description providing a warning and the space left on the disk.

cands.name: dskIndex
cands.description: Integer reference number (row number) for the disk mib.

cands.name: dskMinPercent
cands.description: Percentage of minimum space required on the disk before the errors are triggered. Either this or dskMinimum is configured via the agent's snmpd.conf file.

cands.name: dskMinimum
cands.description: Minimum space required on the disk (in kBytes) before the errors are triggered. Either this or dskMinPercent is configured via the agent's snmpd.conf file.

cands.name: dskPath
cands.description: Path where the disk is mounted.

cands.name: dskPercent
cands.description: Percentage of space used on disk

cands.name: dskPercentNode
cands.description: Percentage of inodes used on disk

cands.name: dskTotal
cands.description: Total size of the disk/partion (kBytes). For large disks (>2Tb), this value will latch at INT32_MAX (2147483647).

cands.name: dskTotalHigh
cands.description: Total size of the disk/partion (kBytes). Together with dskTotalLow composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: dskTotalLow
cands.description: Total size of the disk/partion (kBytes). Together with dskTotalHigh composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: dskUsed
cands.description: Used space on the disk. For large heavily-used disks (>2Tb), this value will latch at INT32_MAX (2147483647).

cands.name: dskUsedHigh
cands.description: Used space on the disk (kBytes). Together with dskUsedLow composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: dskUsedLow
cands.description: Used space on the disk (kBytes). Together with dskUsedHigh composes 64-bit number.

cands.name: extCommand
cands.description: The command line to be executed.

cands.name: extErrFix
cands.description: Setting this to one will try to fix the problem if the agent has been configured with a script to call to attempt to fix problems automatically using remote snmp operations.

cands.name: extErrFixCmd
cands.description: The command that gets run when the extErrFix column is set to 1.

cands.name: extIndex
cands.description: Reference Index for extensible scripts. Simply an integer row number.

cands.name: extNames
cands.description: A Short, one name description of the extensible command.

cands.name: extOutput
cands.description: The first line of output of the executed command.

cands.name: extResult
cands.description: The result code (exit status) from the executed command.

cands.name: fileErrorFlag
cands.description: Limit exceeded flag

cands.name: fileErrorMsg
cands.description: Filesize error message

cands.name: fileIndex
cands.description: Index of file

cands.name: fileMax
cands.description: Limit of filesize (kB)

cands.name: fileName
cands.description: Filename

cands.name: fileSize
cands.description: Size of file (kB)

cands.name: laConfig
cands.description: The watch point for load-averages to signal an error. If the load averages rises above this value, the laErrorFlag below is set.

cands.name: laErrMessage
cands.description: An error message describing the load-average and its surpased watch-point value.

cands.name: laErrorFlag
cands.description: A Error flag to indicate the load-average has crossed its threshold value defined in the snmpd.conf file. It is set to 1 if the threshold is crossed, 0 otherwise.

cands.name: laIndex
cands.description: reference index/row number for each observed loadave.

cands.name: laLoad
cands.description: The 1,5 and 15 minute load averages (one per row).

cands.name: laLoadFloat
cands.description: The 1,5 and 15 minute load averages as an opaquely wrapped floating point number.

cands.name: laLoadInt
cands.description: The 1,5 and 15 minute load averages as an integer. This is computed by taking the floating point loadaverage value and multiplying by 100, then converting the value to an integer.

cands.name: laNames
cands.description: The list of loadave names we're watching.

cands.name: logMatchCount
cands.description: Description.

cands.name: logMatchCounter
cands.description: Regex match counter. This counter will be reset with each read

cands.name: logMatchCurrentCount
cands.description: Description.

cands.name: logMatchCurrentCounter
cands.description: Regex match counter. This counter will be reset with each logfile rotation.

cands.name: logMatchCycle
cands.description: time between updates (if not queried) in seconds

cands.name: logMatchErrorFlag
cands.description: errorflag: is this line configured correctly?

cands.name: logMatchFilename
cands.description: filename to be logmatched

cands.name: logMatchGlobalCount
cands.description: Description.

cands.name: logMatchGlobalCounter
cands.description: global count of matches

cands.name: logMatchIndex
cands.description: Index of logmatch

cands.name: logMatchMaxEntries
cands.description: The maximum number of logmatch entries this snmpd daemon can support.

cands.name: logMatchName
cands.description: logmatch instance name

cands.name: logMatchRegEx
cands.description: regular expression

cands.name: logMatchRegExCompilation
cands.description: message of regex precompilation

cands.name: memAvailReal
cands.description: The amount of real/physical memory currently unused or available.

cands.name: memAvailRealTXT
cands.description: The amount of real/physical memory currently being used by text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of physical memory. Note that (despite the name), this value reports the amount used,

cands.name: memAvailRealX
cands.description: The amount of real/physical memory currently unused or available.

cands.name: memAvailSwap
cands.description: The amount of swap space currently unused or available.

cands.name: memAvailSwapTXT
cands.description: The amount of swap space or virtual memory currently being used by text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of swap space or virtual memory. Note that (despite the name), this value rep

cands.name: memAvailSwapX
cands.description: The amount of swap space currently unused or available.

cands.name: memBuffer
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as memory buffers. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memBufferX
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as memory buffers. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memCached
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as cached memory. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memCachedX
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as cached memory. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memErrorName
cands.description: Bogus Name. This should always return the string 'swap'.

cands.name: memIndex
cands.description: Bogus Index. This should always return the integer 0.

cands.name: memMinimumSwap
cands.description: The minimum amount of swap space expected to be kept free or available during normal operation of this host. If this value (as reported by 'memAvailSwap(4)') falls below the specified level, then 'memSwapError(100)' will be set to 1 and an error message made available via 'memSwapErrorMsg(101)'.

cands.name: memMinimumSwapX
cands.description: The minimum amount of swap space expected to be kept free or available during normal operation of this host. If this value (as reported by 'memAvailSwap(4)') falls below the specified level, then 'memSwapError(100)' will be set to 1 and an error message made available via 'memSwapErrorMsg(101)'.

cands.name: memShared
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as shared memory. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memSharedX
cands.description: The total amount of real or virtual memory currently allocated for use as shared memory. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose.

cands.name: memSwapError
cands.description: Indicates whether the amount of available swap space (as reported by 'memAvailSwap(4)'), is less than the desired minimum (specified by 'memMinimumSwap(12)').

cands.name: memSwapErrorMsg
cands.description: Describes whether the amount of available swap space (as reported by 'memAvailSwap(4)'), is less than the desired minimum (specified by 'memMinimumSwap(12)').

cands.name: memSysAvail
cands.description: The total amount of available memory, which is an estimate of how much memory is available for starting new applications, without swapping. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not explicitly identify memory as specifically reserved for this purpose

cands.name: memTotalFree
cands.description: The total amount of memory free or available for use on this host. This value typically covers both real memory and swap space or virtual memory.

cands.name: memTotalFreeX
cands.description: The total amount of memory free or available for use on this host. This value typically covers both real memory and swap space or virtual memory.

cands.name: memTotalReal
cands.description: The total amount of real/physical memory installed on this host.

cands.name: memTotalRealTXT
cands.description: The total amount of real/physical memory allocated for text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of physical memory.

cands.name: memTotalRealX
cands.description: The total amount of real/physical memory installed on this host.

cands.name: memTotalSwap
cands.description: The total amount of swap space configured for this host.

cands.name: memTotalSwapTXT
cands.description: The total amount of swap space or virtual memory allocated for text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of swap space or virtual memory.

cands.name: memTotalSwapX
cands.description: The total amount of swap space configured for this host.

cands.name: memUsedRealTXT
cands.description: The amount of real/physical memory currently being used by text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of physical memory.

cands.name: memUsedSwapTXT
cands.description: The amount of swap space or virtual memory currently being used by text pages on this host. This object will not be implemented on hosts where the underlying operating system does not distinguish text pages from other uses of swap space or virtual memory.

cands.name: mrIndex
cands.description: The registry slot of a mibmodule.

cands.name: mrModuleName
cands.description: The module name that registered this OID.

cands.name: prCount
cands.description: The number of current processes running with the name in question.

cands.name: prErrFix
cands.description: Setting this to one will try to fix the problem if the agent has been configured with a script to call to attempt to fix problems automatically using remote snmp operations.

cands.name: prErrFixCmd
cands.description: The command that gets run when the prErrFix column is set to 1.

cands.name: prErrMessage
cands.description: An error message describing the problem (if one exists).

cands.name: prErrorFlag
cands.description: A Error flag to indicate trouble with a process. It goes to 1 if there is an error, 0 if no error.

cands.name: prIndex
cands.description: Reference Index for each observed process.

cands.name: prMax
cands.description: The maximum number of processes that should be running. An error flag is generated if the number of running processes is > the maximum.

cands.name: prMin
cands.description: The minimum number of processes that should be running. An error flag is generated if the number of running processes is < the minimum.

cands.name: prNames
cands.description: The process name we're counting/checking on.

cands.name: snmperrErrMessage
cands.description: An error message describing the problem (if one exists).

cands.name: snmperrErrorFlag
cands.description: A Error flag to indicate trouble with the agent. It goes to 1 if there is an error, 0 if no error.

cands.name: snmperrIndex
cands.description: Bogus Index for snmperrs (always 0).

cands.name: snmperrNames
cands.description: snmp
